scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @devfolio/shared && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm:dev --workspace @devfolio/api" "npm:dev --workspace @devfolio/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @devfolio/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @devfolio/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
